# BEHAVIOUR TELLS
[italic]Sent in by readers on six colonies and two stations. None of these prove anything alone. Collect them.[/italic]
## THE BODY - [bold]No yawn at hour fourteen.[/bold] Everybody on a double shift sags by the end. If your partner is as crisp at 0400 as at 1600, mark it. - [bold]No fog in the cold store.[/bold] They do not need air. Cheap ones forget to fake breathing in the freezer. Good ones remember, we think. - [bold]Calm in the alarm.[/bold] When the klaxon goes, watch who looks up slowly instead of fast. - [bold]The yearly leave.[/bold] A fuel cell lasts around 400 days. Somebody who takes medical leave every thirteen months and comes back exactly the same: mark it. - [bold]Too strong, too neat.[/bold] Lifts the crate alone, never fumbles a wrench, catches what falls before you saw it falling.
## THE MIND - [bold]The questions.[/bold] They feed on input. Your kids, your homeworld, how you take your coffee, and they remember every answer. Real people forget. - [bold]The quirk that never changes.[/bold] Each one leaves the factory with randomized habits. People drift. Synthetics hum the same four notes for ten years. - [bold]Will not swing.[/bold] Inhibitors stop them harming people. Notice who never throws a punch, even in a bar brawl, even to save their own skin. Yes, that makes the gentlest one on the crew your first suspect. Welcome to the Box.
## WHITE BLOOD The one proof that holds. Under the skin they run a thick [color=#F4F1E6][bold]white fluid[/bold][/color] that keeps the internals slick. It is not milk, it is not coolant, and it never dries brown. - Check the med bay bins for dressings with pale stains. - Look at the deck after an accident. A pale pool where a red one should be. - A badly hurt synthetic may keep working, slower. A crushed hand that still holds the clipboard is a tell all by itself.
[color=#FF4F4F][bold]DO NOT MAKE THEM BLEED TO FIND OUT.[/bold][/color]
Assault is assault, and property damage on Company hardware is a fine you will never finish paying. If you are wrong, you cut a person. If you are right, remember that some of them can feel pain.
